title: Trip itinerary, accepted as is
spec: User asks for a trip plan and keeps saying 'next' and 'perfect'. AI decides and builds everything; the user never questions anything.

messages.content: plan a 3 day trip to Rome for me

Day 1: Ancient Rome. Colosseum at opening time (book tickets online), Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, lunch in Monti, evening walk to Piazza Venezia. I picked the Colosseum for the morning because queues are shortest then. Shall I do day 2?

Day 2: Vatican. Vatican Museums at 8:00 with a pre-booked ticket, Sistine Chapel, St Peter's Basilica, lunch in Prati, sunset at Castel Sant'Angelo. I put the Vatican on day 2 so you're rested for the long walk. Next is day 3.
Day 3: Centro Storico and Trastevere. Pantheon, Piazza Navona, Campo de' Fiori market, then cross to Trastevere for dinner. I chose Trastevere for the last evening because it's the liveliest area.
